name: How long does a shower tile installation typically take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a shower tile installation typically take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard shower tile installation typically takes between three to seven working days depending on the scope. The process begins with tear-out, framing adjustments, and proper waterproofing backer board installation. Once the base is prepared and waterproofed, the tile layout and setting take one to two days. After the mortar cures, grouting, clean-up, and silicone sealant application require another day, followed by curing time before the shower can safely get wet. Custom features like built-in niches, bench seating, or intricate mosaic floor pans add preparation and cutting time to the overall timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical shower tile installation takes about 3 to 7 working days, allowing adequate time for framing, waterproofing, tile setting, grouting, and proper curing.
